subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw expose sibling-agent roster metadata to model-visible session context, and should that exposure be always-on prompt context or a gated `agents_list`/tool contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested metadata includes agent topology, roles, and permission state, so maintainers need to choose the product and security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Extend gated agents_list
options.body: Expose only metadata for already allowed targets through the existing allowlist-aware tool, with bounded fields and tests before revisiting prompt injection.

options.title: Inject prompt roster
options.body: Add a prompt section for sibling metadata, accepting extra prompt surface and topology exposure as deliberate product behavior.

options.title: Reject core exposure
options.body: Keep sibling details out of core prompt/tool output and rely on manually maintained or plugin-owned discovery instead.

recommendation.title: Extend gated agents_list
recommendation.body: Expose only metadata for already allowed targets through the existing allowlist-aware tool, with bounded fields and tests before revisiting prompt injection.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced `agents_list` and has the strongest current feature-history signal for the multi-agent discovery boundary.
